title: The Wardrobe of the old quarter
author: E. M. Ravensworth
blurb: Rosalind Whitlock, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must return to the place where the story went wrong before the house sale closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
